description: A filter or sort token (DESIGN.md, Chip): TsuyaSize.controlSm tall, TsuyaRadius.sm, a TsuyaColors.fill with a hairline; accent-filled with TsuyaColors.onAccent content when selected. A glass variant over content.

params.name: label
params.description: The chip's one-line label; ellipsized if it must.

params.name: onPressed
params.description: Called on a press; null disables it.

params.name: icon
params.description: Before the label, in TsuyaColors.textMuted (or on-accent when selected).

params.name: glass
params.description: Control glass instead of the fill and hairline.

params.name: focusNode
params.description: The node to track focus with, when the caller manages one (ChipGroup sets its own).

params.name: autofocus
params.description: Focuses it as soon as it is built.

params.name: checked
params.description: Announces it as one radio of a mutually exclusive group rather than a toggle, as a single-select ChipGroup does ("selected" rather than "pressed").
